items.title: 初次见面
items.text: 芭芭拉，闪耀登场~治疗就交给我吧，不会让你失望的！
items.text_en: Tada! *giggles* Barbara is here~ Leave the healing to me, I will not disappoint you!

items.title: 闲聊·犯困
items.text: 再这样站下去，会…想睡觉的…
items.text_en: *yawn* All this standing around is making me so sleepy...

items.title: 闲聊·激励
items.text: 大家应该都在努力着，那我们也不能偷懒，对吧？
items.text_en: Everyone is working super hard, we should be too!

items.title: 闲聊·提神秘诀
items.text: 欸，是没精神了吗？尝一尝我做的辣味饮料吧，很提神的喔！
items.text_en: Are you tired? Try my new spicy energy drink, I'm sure it'll wake you up!

items.title: 下雨的时候
items.text: 这样淋着不要紧吗？会感冒的吧？
items.text_en: Don't stay out in the rain for too long, you'll catch a cold!

items.title: 打雷的时候
items.text: 呜哇！
items.text_en: Whoa!

items.title: 下雪的时候
items.text: 欸！是雪花欸！冰冰凉凉的~！
items.text_en: Ooh, snowflakes! Look at them dance!

items.title: 阳光很好
items.text: 这样的好天气，嗯~适合比较明快的曲风呢！
items.text_en: This weather is so amazing! I could burst into song.

items.title: 刮大风了
items.text: 放心，我不会被吹走的！
items.text_en: Don't worry! I will not... be blown away!

items.title: 早上好
items.text: 早安~今天也要加油呀。
items.text_en: Morning~ Let's do our best today.

items.title: 中午好
items.text: 欸，想听我唱歌…？对不起，还…还没有到演出时间呢。
items.text_en: Oh? You want to hear me sing...? Sorry, the show is... It hasn't started yet.

items.title: 晚上好
items.text: 想吃猎鹿人餐馆的香辣鲈鱼…可是最近的肚子，呜…
items.text_en: I really want to eat some spicy squid at Good Hunter... but my stomach, er... Never mind...

items.title: 晚安
items.text: 辛苦了！请好好休息吧。
items.text_en: We had a great day today! Get some rest.

items.title: 关于芭芭拉自己
items.text: 「指引我前进的风啊。在我困顿时给我继续前行的力量，在我迷惑时给我辨明善恶的智慧，在我遭受不义时给我抗争的勇气…」…哎呀，抱歉，刚才在专心祈祷。有什么事吗？
items.text_en: "To the wind that guides me: When I'm exhausted, bless me with the strength to keep going forward. When I'm uncertain, bless me with the wisdom to distinguish good from evil. When I suffer from injustice, bless me with the courage to fight back..." ...Oops, my apologies, I was just doing my prayers. *giggles* You need something?

items.title: 关于我们·愿望
items.text: 我的愿望，是给身边的大家带来笑容！只要能帮上你的忙，我就很开心了。
items.text_en: My dream is to bring a smile to the faces of all the people in my life! As long as I can help you on your journey, I'm happy~

items.title: 关于我们·梦想
items.text: 谢谢你陪我走到现在，离我的梦想已经越来越近了呢。未来的日子，也请多多关照啦~！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Thank you for being with me for all this time, I can feel that I'm getting closer to my dream. Hope we can keep this up in the future~!

items.title: 关于「神之眼」
items.text: 每个人都会有自己的愿望。汇聚大家的愿望，让大家感到幸福，这一定，就是神给予我的使命吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Everyone has their own desires. To bring together and fulfill those desires and make everyone happy — this is the purpose my Archon has bestowed upon me.

items.title: 有什么想要分享
items.text: 蒙德城外青青的原野，真的百看不厌。但我听说，世界上还有蓝色的树林呢！就在海对岸的稻妻城那边。嗯！我还得多攒一点…欸？问我在攒什么？嘿嘿，是秘密哦~！
items.text_en: I could never get bored of the breathtakingly beautiful nature that surrounds Mondstadt. I've heard that there are blue trees that exist by the sea shore near Inazuma City. I just need to save up a little more, and... What's that? You want to know what I'm saving up for? *chuckles* That's my little secret.

items.title: 感兴趣的见闻
items.text: 向日葵一直对着阳光的样子，很耀眼呢。其实，妈妈送过我一条向日葵风格的礼裙…但我什么时候才能穿上它去演出呢？
items.text_en: Sunflowers always face the sun. They're so bright. In fact, my mother sent me a sunflower-style dress... I wonder when I'll finally get to wear it on stage?

items.title: 关于琴
items.text: 代理团长大人…骑士团的领袖，大家都很喜欢她哦。欸？问我吗？我…我当然也非常尊敬她！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Acting Grand Master... Leader of the Knights of Favonius... Everyone seems to like her a lot. Oh? Me? I... Of course I have nothing but admiration for her!

items.title: 关于丽莎
items.text: 我一直承蒙丽莎姐姐照顾呢。要是她也成为偶像的话，我绝对会全力应援，喊到嗓子哑掉…啊，这样会吓到别人的吧…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I always take good care of Lisa. If she ever wants to become a star, she'll have my unconditional support, I'll cheer at the top of my lungs until my voice goes hoarse... Hmm, that might scare off her other fans though...

items.title: 关于安柏
items.text: 以前就经常看到安柏风风火火地往城外跑，侦察骑士还真是辛苦呀。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I've seen Amber rushing out of Mondstadt on a mission countless times. Being an Outrider doesn't look easy.

items.title: 关于迪卢克
items.text: 迪卢克老爷吗？上次在「天使的馈赠」演出，他一直皱着眉头…是不是我唱的歌他不喜欢呢？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Oh, Master Diluc? Last time, when I was performing at Angel's Share, he kept frowning... Maybe he doesn't like my singing?

items.title: 关于温迪
items.text: 温迪的声音很好听！不过，他唱的歌跟我擅长的风格差异很大。我试着偷偷学过…那旋律还真是复杂呀。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Venti's voice is amazing! But the songs he sings and the ones I'm good at are very different. I tried to learn them but... the melodies are just so complicated.

items.title: 关于班尼特
items.text: 班尼特经常带着一身伤痕来教堂…他却一直毫不在意、大大咧咧地笑着。唔…还是应该更爱惜自己才好啊。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Bennett always comes to the cathedral covered in scrapes and bruises... Though it clearly never bothers him a bit, given the big grin he always has on his face. He really should take better care of himself.

items.title: 关于法尔伽
items.text: 父亲跟着法尔伽大团长一起出远门了，也不知道路途中会不会遇到什么…啊，没关系，大团长可是「北风骑士」，一定没问题的！我…也会为他们祈祷的。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4My father left on the expedition with Grand Master Varka... I hope they are okay. Oh, what am I worried about? The Grand Master is none other than the Knight of Boreas, of course they will be fine! Still, I will be sure to pray for their safe return.

items.title: 关于罗莎莉亚
items.text: 罗莎莉亚修女虽然难以接近，也从不参加祈祷，但我觉得…唔，她一定是相信着风神的！不过，不过我并没有勇气和她交流就是了…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Sister Rosaria is hard to get to know, especially given she never joins in on prayers, but... Oh, I'm sure she believes in the Anemo Archon! Although, I still don't really have the courage to try to talk to her...

items.title: 关于诺艾尔
items.text: 诺艾尔实在是太可爱了！人又温柔，还很有耐心，跟她在一起的时候，完全不会有什么压力…哦，对了，她做的茶点也很特别。又香，又甜，而且很健康，嘿嘿。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Noelle is just the cutest! She's so kind and patient, you just feel totally relaxed when you're around her. ...Oh yeah, and she makes the tastiest snacks! Best part is, they're also healthy. Tee-hee!

items.title: 想要了解芭芭拉·其一
items.text: 骑士们挥剑作战的样子好帅啊！你是不是也有这种感觉？我自己也试过用剑…欸嘿嘿，可惜我在剑术上，完全没有天赋呢。
items.text_en: Knights look so cool when they swing their sword in combat! Don't you think so? I tried using a sword before but... *sigh* Uh, let's just say I have zero talent with a sword.

items.title: 想要了解芭芭拉·其二
items.text: 想要治愈大家。就是这么简单的心情，让我成为了牧师。要是能帮上大家就好了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 3I want to heal everyone. This simple thought was all the motivation I needed to become a Deaconess. As long as I'm able to help everyone, I'll be content.

items.title: 想要了解芭芭拉·其三
items.text: 偶像，唔...是从艾莉丝那边了解到的…「优秀的偶像能够治愈人们的心灵。」嗯，嗯，总之就是这样啦。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Being an idol, I learned from Alice that "A true idol should always try to heal the soul of the people..." Yes, I completely agree.

items.title: 想要了解芭芭拉·其四
items.text: 我每天都在努力，这份努力…如果能配得上蒙德城大家的信任…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 5I'm doing my best everyday... I hope my efforts earn the trust of the people of Mondstadt.

items.title: 想要了解芭芭拉·其五
items.text: 每次演出的时候我都会想…我真的能够治愈蒙德城里的每个人么？但是看着你，我总觉得只要一步步向前，总有一天…欸？至少已经把你治愈了…？这时候不是应该说！我已经治愈很多人了吗？！不过这样也不错…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Every time I get on stage I always start to doubt myself — can I really heal every person in Mondstadt? But I look at you now, and I feel that as long as we keep marching forward, maybe one day I might just— Huh? I've already healed you? Well, one's not enough! I've already healed a lot of people? I suppose...

items.title: 芭芭拉的爱好
items.text: 是大家脸上的笑容，一直在支持我。
items.text_en: The smiles on the faces of the people I've helped keeps me going.

items.title: 芭芭拉的烦恼
items.text: 同伴们一直在受伤…我，没有替大家分担痛苦的力量。但我可以尽最大的努力治疗！一定，要让大家恢复健康。
items.text_en: My companions keep getting injured, but I'm unable to share the burden of their pain. The only thing I can do is my absolute very best to heal their wounds! I'll make sure that everyone is healthy.

items.title: 喜欢的食物
items.text: 你喜欢麻辣小鱼干吗？我这还有两条…喏，给你一条！
items.text_en: Do you like spicy dried fish? I have two in my bag. Here, have one!

items.title: 讨厌的食物
items.text: 我不太喜欢苦的东西，特别是…苦瓜。
items.text_en: I don't like anything bitter, especially... ugh, bitter gourd.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其一
items.text: 很少吃到那么合我口味的菜肴。今天是幸运日呢！
items.text_en: It's a rare pleasure to eat food that suits my tastes so well. Today is a blessed day!

items.title: 收到赠礼·其二
items.text: 谢谢你特意做的这些，这次，是被你治愈了。
items.text_en: Thank you for cooking these for me. This time around, you are the one healing me!

items.title: 收到赠礼·其三
items.text: 不，不好…
items.text_en: Oh, uh, oh dear...

items.title: 生日
items.text: 请收下！这个是给你的生日礼物，专属签名绘哟~欸嘿，等下一首新歌，我会第一时间唱给你听的！生日快乐呀！
items.text_en: Here you go! This is the gift I got for your birthday, along with my exclusive autograph! Hehe, when my next song comes out, I'll make sure you're the first one to hear it! Happy birthday!

items.title: 突破的感受·起
items.text: 芭芭拉的舞步…治愈力UP！
items.text_en: Unlocks at ascension phase 1A dance from Barbara, to bring you more healing!

items.title: 突破的感受·承
items.text: 谢谢你的支持~啊，不好，好像有点太激动了…心脏怦怦跳个不停。
items.text_en: Unlocks at ascension phase 2Aw, thank you so much for your support! Oh no, I'm too excited, my heart just can't stop racing!

items.title: 突破的感受·转
items.text: 请告诉我继续变强的秘诀~欸？放心交给你就行？…这怎么行，我也要一起努力！
items.text_en: Unlocks at ascension phase 4Please, tell me how I can be stronger! Just leave it up to you? No, no, that won't do! I want to help too!

items.title: 突破的感受·合
items.text: 和你一起旅行，我才意识到舞台是没有边界的。谢谢你！嘿嘿…好！一起喊出那句咒语吧！三、二、一，——芭芭拉冲呀！
items.text_en: Unlocks at ascension phase 6Traveling with you, I have discovered that the world is my stage! Thank you so much! *giggles* Ok! Let's shout it one more time! Three, two, one — Go Barbara, go!

items.title: 元素战技·其一
items.text: 我会保护大家！
items.text_en: I'll protect us!

items.title: 元素战技·其二
items.text: 打起精神来哟！
items.text_en: Let's dance!

items.title: 元素战技·其三
items.text: 演唱，开始！
items.text_en: Let the show begin!

items.title: 元素爆发·其一
items.text: ♪哼哼哼~哼哼~
items.text_en: ♪La la-la-la-la~

items.title: 元素爆发·其二
items.text: 准备好了吗~
items.text_en: Ready, steady go!

items.title: 元素爆发·其三
items.text: 大家加油喔！
items.text_en: Come on, we can do it!

items.title: 冲刺开始·其一
items.text: 芭芭拉，冲呀！
items.text_en: Go Barbara, go!

items.title: 冲刺结束·其一
items.text: 呼…呼…没问题！
items.text_en: *pant*... I'm fine!

items.title: 冲刺结束·其二
items.text: 能跟得上！
items.text_en: *pant* Keep going...

items.title: 打开宝箱·其一
items.text: 想用歌声，带给人们同样的惊喜。
items.text_en: This is the kind of surprise I could sing about.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其二
items.text: 光彩熠熠！
items.text_en: Oh, look at it sparkle!

items.title: 打开宝箱·其三
items.text: 嗯哼♪真是幸运的一天~
items.text_en: Hmm hmm hmm♪ Things are going so smoothly today~

items.title: 生命值低·其一
items.text: 我没关系的！
items.text_en: Don't worry about me!

items.title: 生命值低·其二
items.text: 为了大家，我还不能…
items.text_en: I can't stop now, they need me!

items.title: 生命值低·其三
items.text: 我再坚持一下…
items.text_en: Gotta keep trying!

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其一
items.text: 我…不想看你受伤。
items.text_en: I don't want to see you hurt...

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其二
items.text: 让我为你治疗，拜托了！
items.text_en: Please, let me tend to your wounds!

items.title: 倒下·其一
items.text: 有点，没力气了…
items.text_en: I feel... a little weak...

items.title: 倒下·其二
items.text: 大家的声音，听不到呢…
items.text_en: Why has everyone stopped singing?

items.title: 倒下·其三
items.text: 姐姐…
items.text_en: Sister...

items.title: 普通受击·其一
items.text: 疼…
items.text_en: Ouchie!

items.title: 重受击·其一
items.text: 讨厌…
items.text_en: Oh no!

items.title: 加入队伍·其一
items.text: 放心交给我就好。
items.text_en: I'll take care of it.

items.title: 加入队伍·其二
items.text: 我会加油的！
items.text_en: Wish me luck!

items.title: 加入队伍·其三
items.text: 一起努力吧！
items.text_en: We can do this!
